Thank you, Madam Chair. This next record is requesting approval to proceed with the ICI recycling and organics regulation compliance and education work in 2022 and 2023 by re-elegating capital funds.

Last year City Council approved the waste amendment by law that outlines the requirements for recycling and organics that version programs for industrial, commercial and institutional properties in Saskatoon.

The waste by law now requires the ICI sector to have separate containers for a single bone materials, provide and provide education to employees on proper waste handling, as well as ensuring materials are taken to an appropriate facility.
Similar regulations for organics will come into place in July 2023 for organizations that generate food or yard waste as part of their operations.

While the regulations within the by law can be in place without formal education and enforcement, the likelihood of achieving the waste diversion targets is higher with dedicated resources for these aspects of the program.

The administration has reviewed the appropriate and the approved capital budget and identified opportunities to adjust the scope of various waste related programs in order to fund these important aspects of the ICI program.

Specifically, 159,400 is recommended to be reallocated from the multi-unit organics project. This results in a reduction of scope to the multi-unit organics program by differing the equal ambassador program pilot.
